title: From Classic Genetics to Cutting-Edge Biotech: Exploring the Genetic Tools Enabling Protein Expression in Fruit Flies
summary: In biotechnology today, there is a growing demand for recombinant proteins across multiple sectors, and specifically a demand for manufacturing capacity and capabilities in producing difficult-to-express proteins (DTEPs). Protein expression is a complex activity–from transcription to translation with hundreds of interrelated variables at play.
